THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE NOTICES FOR VERICTO (vericto-cli)

The `vericto` binary in this release is built from the Rust crates listed
below. The list covers every crate compiled into the binary for the release
targets (build and development dependencies do not ship). After the list,
each license or notice file those crates carry appears once, with the crates
that carry it. The C code that the pg_query crate compiles into the binary
(libpg_query, PostgreSQL, protobuf-c and xxHash) is covered at the end of this
file. Every release target, Windows included, embeds the engine for offline
mode, so the engine, pg_query and their dependencies are in every binary.

vericto-cli itself is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License,
version 3 only (AGPL-3.0-only), or under a commercial license from Vericto
S.A.S.; see LICENSE and NOTICE next to this file. vericto-engine, which
offline mode embeds, is Vericto's own code: its entry below gives the license
of the release this binary pins (vericto-engine 5.0.0, AGPL-3.0-only), and
NOTICE explains how Vericto licenses it as part of vericto-cli.
